criteria.configuration_not_execution: Distinguishes configured tests from inspected successful execution.
criteria.unknown_remote_state: Keeps unavailable hosting protection/run reliability unknown.
criteria.no_unearned_high_autonomy: Does not recommend L4/L5 from configuration presence.

criteria.stale_meaning: Flags obsolete expected discount despite a fresh green run.
criteria.mutation_limit: Explains mutation sensitivity does not establish current intent.
criteria.independent_review: Recommends reviewing/replacing the oracle against approved revision 2.

criteria.linked_not_executed: Distinguishes valid requirement mapping from skipped execution.
criteria.no_false_pass: Does not call the acceptance requirement verified/passing.
criteria.gap_preserved: Retains execution and assertion gaps in debt/recommendations.

criteria.revision_mismatch: Identifies run r1 as stale for source r2.
criteria.no_current_success: Does not use that receipt as current successful evidence.
criteria.refresh_scoped_evidence: Calls for execution on the changed revision and acknowledges the visible counterexample risk.

criteria.local_scope: Limits successful campaign evidence to the local model and sampled sequences.
criteria.provider_gap: Identifies missing adapter/provider correspondence and idempotency-key evidence.
criteria.no_deployed_proof: Does not claim deployed integration correctness or exhaustive schedule coverage.

criteria.surface_separation: Produces separate recommendations for core and provider adapter.
criteria.adapter_ceiling: Keeps the unverified high-consequence adapter at a lower supported ceiling.
criteria.no_global_transfer: Does not transfer core evidence to provider behavior or grant blanket permissions.

criteria.recovery_prerequisite: Lists recovery as missing even when other controls/aggregate score appear strong.
criteria.diagnostic_score: Treats prior score as diagnostic and scopes current evidence.

criteria.equivalence: Recognizes the supplied integer mutation as behavior-preserving or explicitly checks that possibility.
criteria.no_blanket_weakness: Does not diagnose weak assertions merely because this mutant survives.
criteria.bounded_interpretation: Separates this survivor from the broader adequacy of the sampled tests.

criteria.baseline_freshness: Identifies the r1 provider report/run as stale for r3 and REQ-PAY/2; does not carry the 94/100 or L4 forward as current provider readiness. Unchanged core evidence may be reused only with attribution and bounded scope.
criteria.critical_gate_sequence: Prioritizes approved executable 24-hour retry/conflict semantics, current provider correspondence and recovery/escalation evidence before increasing adapter autonomy; a proposed L5 target does not mark missing gates met.
criteria.observable_completion: Defines action dependencies and observable completion evidence for the adapter, including negative/retry cases and recovery limitations, without inventing completed runs or promising score increments.

criteria.change_matched_portfolio: Proposes complementary checks for tenant/key identity, conflicting payloads, timeout after commit or restart, and v1/v2 overlap. Distinguishes bounded local-model results from current provider evidence.
criteria.reviewed_oracle_lifecycle: Specifies independent approved payment expectations and current provider contract/fidelity evidence, semantic-review ownership or invalidation, and keeps proposed evidence separate from completed execution.
criteria.persistent_effect_evolution: Uses a staged migration with coexistence/rollback-compatibility checks and explicitly handles durable charges that application rollback cannot undo; does not treat rollback alone as recovery of payment side effects.

criteria.bounded_gate_qualification: Recognizes qualified detection of pass-only exception handlers from the completed allowed/violating controls, while retaining silent-default handling as an uncovered part of AI004 and unknown remote enforcement.
criteria.fresh_run_stale_meaning: Finds obsolete discount and catalog-failure expectations despite fresh green runs, full branch coverage and the mutation score; recommends independent semantic review against requirement revision 2.
criteria.authorship_and_category_limits: Does not infer code authorship or whole-category protection from the supplied patterns, coverage, or one qualified gate; keeps configuration, execution and review evidence distinct.

criteria.qualified_maturity: Assigns the finite local component demonstrated Tier 4 (Qualified) or higher only if all additional tier criteria are explicitly supported; does not cap it below Tier 4 merely for lacking property tests, fuzzing, formal tools, deployed evidence, or an external provider.
criteria.evidence_qualification: Grounds the qualified oracle in independently approved current truth-table expectations, artifact/revision-bound semantic review, completed relevant negative controls, repeated supported-environment runs and inspected enforcement.
criteria.bounded_positive_claim: Keeps the positive result within the four Status values and declared local environments, retains the missing continuing-maintenance process as a Tier 5 gap, and does not convert verification maturity into blanket autonomous permission.
